eps.d: Sabrina becomes a race car driver, Bosley, a preacher and Jill, his daughter to learn why a pretty woman driver lost control of her car and died in a flaming wreck.
Charlie assigns the girls to find the saboteurs of a charter plane carrying a cache of heroin.
Charlie counts on Kelly's striking resemblance to a fashion model who was a victim in a series of rag doll stranglings.
The Angels investigate a country prison farm and a nearby small-town sheriff.
An unknown assassin tries to kill Jill, Kelly and Sabrina.
Charlie calls on the Angels to solve the murder of the daughter of an old friend at an exclusive hotel-resort.
Kelly is accidentally shot when she takes Skip, an autistic little boy, on an outing to an amusement park.
Jill becomes a candidate for the centerfold of "Feline Magazine", hoping to tempt the hand of the murderer of two previous models.
A recruit in the Women's Army Corps is shot to death on the firing range and Charlie's Angels are assigned to investigate.
A prostitute supplied by a computer dating service keeps an antique dealer preoccupied while his store is burgled of priceless art objects.

A rich widow hires the Angels to solve the mystery of the repeated disappearances of her jewelry. When they learn the lady manages her affairs through a medium, they track down prime suspect, Madame Dorian. Kelly assumes the identity of a rich Texas widow, Jill becomes her friend, and Bosley, their French chauffeur.

Jill becomes the star of a roller derby team when she goes undercover to investigate the mysterious death of skating champ Karen Jason, who is killed after being forced over the guardrail and into the audience during a rough and tumble race.
Jericho, a paradoxically gentle man who was a World War II French Underground assassin, is the prime suspect when a former member of his old liberationist team is killed.
When notorious gambler-thief Roy David is suspected of burglarizing a securities company of $40,000, the Angels are called into the case to convict him of the crime.
An international political leader is abducted and a double substituted for him at a world conference being held at a resort where the Angels are vacationing.
A legitimate business is targeted for arson and the Angels are called in to investigate.
The Angels investigate Cass Harper, who hires girls for a Las Vegas nightclub chorus line as a front for a prostitution ring.
Jill and Kelly pose as student nurses at the hospital and Sabrina as a local writer preparing a story on a mysterious attacker in a hospital.
A lonely widow is blackmailed after a short affair with a gigolo she met at her dance classes.
Aging actress Gloria Gibson seems to be losing her mind, reliving the death scenes from her old movies.
In a series of "accidents" aboard a cruise ship, a young couple is murdered. The Angels take a trip to Hawaii to investigate for the ship's owner, who is on the verge of bankruptcy.
When two men are found dead in a massage parlor, the Angels are called in to investigate the policeman who reported the crime.
Just as Jill leaves the team to pursue a career racing cars and new Angel Kris Munroe joins the team, someone kidnaps Charlie in Hawaii!
The Angels continue to search for Charlie, with the help of the husband of the kidnapper, who they broke out of police custody.
Personnel keep disappearing from Max Brown's ice show, so he hires Charlie and the angels to investigate.

eps.t: Pretty Angels All in a Row
eps.d: The Angels become beauty contestants to find out who is scaring off the contestants.
When a college friend who teaches stewardesses is being stalked, the Angels come aboard to fly the not so friendly skies.
The Angels join the circus to uncover who is behind all the "accidents" that threaten to close it for good.
While the Angels are tracking down clues to the murder of a health resort employee, they uncover a $2 million aircraft hijacking mystery.
UFOs, mysterious disappearances and the murder of a wealthy old lady put the Angels on the trail of a killer...from another world?
The Angels join a radio station's new staff to prevent the murder of a beautiful reporter while Kris investigates a Charles Manson-like hippie.
The Angels investigate a murder and discover a shocking traffic in black market babies.
Kris is singing "Sweet Misery" when she appears in a movie musical to help find out who is trying to kill actress Ellen Jason.
The Angels are hired to clear magician Wendell Muse as the prime suspect in mysterious arson fires set by the "Magic Man."
The Angels become bodyguards for Sammy Davis, Jr. to protect him from further kidnapping attempts.
The Angels go to a dude ranch to find out who has killed one of the guests.
The Angels join the tennis circuit as top players become victims of accidents and murder.
After two diamond crooks are double-crossed, they take the Angels hostage to help the crooks retrieve their stolen diamonds.
The Angels are hired by Freddie the Fox to help steal back a diamond and return it to its rightful owner.
The Angels tackle a bunch of crooks who are trying to knock a women's football team out of the game!
When investigating a cosmetics company, the Angels must stop a strangler obsessed with blue-eyed blonde women or Kris will be his next victim.
The Angels retrace the steps surrounding the mysterious death of a country-western singer.

eps.t: Mother Goose is Running for His Life
eps.d: Deadly toys are appearing at the Mother Goose Toy Company and it's up to the Angels to solve the case.
The Angels go undercover in the twilight world of vice to discover why three beautiful call girls have been murdered.
A beautiful millionaire plays with fire when she betrays a playboy and the Angels have to smoke out her killer. At the same luxury residence, a cat burglar is making the rounds.
An aspiring singer hires the Angels to find her philandering husband who has disappeared.
A space age fuel is stolen and the Angels track down the thieves to an antique car rally, where they pose as Keystone Cops.
When violent and suspicious deaths strike his closest friends, a casino boss hires the Angels to go undercover at the Tropicana Casino in Las Vegas.
When violent and suspicious deaths strike his closest friends, a casino boss hires the Angels to go undercover at the Tropicana Casino in Las Vegas.
The Angels begin some high gear sleuthing when a car explosion kills Jill's fiancé and she becomes the next target in this high-speed adventure.
The Angels are hired by their wheelchair-bound client to find his potential heir.
When a famous stage actress is electrocuted at an exclusive women's spa, the Angels are hired to capture the murderer and find a missing manuscript.
When an ambitious Professional golfer competing for first prize money in a high-profile tournament is suddenly shot, the Angels are brought in to solve the mystery.

With the intent of contacting a beloved nephew who was killed four years earlier in a motorcycle accident, the Angels are hired by his aunt Claire to pose as psychics in order to uncover a possible fraud.
One by one, three sexy cheerleaders are kidnapped by a small band of religious fanatics.

An innocent woman is murdered after she identifies an escaped convict aboard a luxury liner. The Angels are assigned to infiltrate the ship and discover a ring that assists criminals in escaping the country.
Danger is close at the heels of the Angels as Jill joins their search for the killer of a victim who was accidentally discovered by a precocious girl.
After witnessing a murder, Kris suffers from amnesia and wanders away from the crime scene.
When an old friend is targeted to be killed, he leaves an urgent message for Charlie, warning him that someone is out to destroy one of his Angels.
A wealthy gambler is murdered at a racetrack, so the Angels go undercover and discover a scheme involving the losing horse.
While vacationing in Arizona with Kris's family, the Angels learn that gangsters have taken all the women in the small town hostage in exchange for one of their strongmen.
A devious scam is devised by three doppelganger women who pose as the Angels in order to rob a sports arena box office.
When the Angels are summoned to investigate a strangulation, it leads them to the popular Freddie's Disco where they go undercover to prevent another killing.
When a plot to kidnap the President's Special Envoy to the United Nations unravels at the site of the World Pro-Am Ski Competition, a government agent enlists the Angels to protect the envoy.
Sabrina races against time to escape from her captors, the members of an extremist Italian Radical Group, and warn the other Angels of terrorist activity before time runs out.
When Kris is mysteriously kidnapped, Jill returns to town to help locate her sister but soon discovers that she was the real target for a business mogul blaming her for his son's untimely death.
When a murder occurs at a posh all-girls school, the Angels assume false identities only to discover a ring of girls involved in drug and alcohol abuse.
When the Angels investigate the unusual disappearance of two participants in a marathon, Kris and Kelly join the race to literally chase down the suspects.
Bosley becomes annoyed with being so predictable and decides to play a game with the Angels to see if they can figure out the clues to his whereabouts.
When an ex-mobster is targeted for murder, the Angels are called in by his nephew to investigate.
The Angels reminisce with Bosley and Charlie about their three years of working together.
Tiffany Welles joins the Townsend Agency after Sabrina has quit to get married and start a family. Charlie sends his girls on a cruise on the Pacific Princess to catch an art thief.
Kris's growing feelings for Hollister complicates the Angels' attempts to solve the case.
Kris and Tiffany go to Trucking school to investigate an all-female trucking line whose cargo has been stolen under their very noses.
Frank Desmond is released from prison and proceeds to revenge himself on his jailer, Kelly Garrett, by injecting her with heroin.
Kelly is maid of honor at her friend Sharon's wedding. But there are several attempts to murder the groom.
The Angels are hired to catch Damien 'Ice Cat' Roth, a millionaire playboy/jewel thief, who also happens to be in love with former Angel Jill Munroe.
Kris goes undercover as an inmate in Colejo prison to ferret out a gang of jewel thieves operating from there.
When a young music teacher gets beaten up by a local pimp, Kelly and Tiff join his stable as undercover streetwalkers to investigate.
Jill is wooed by a European crown prince while shopping for Charlie's birthday party and immediately gets in the way of an assassin's line of fire.
A young girl is kidnapped while performing as a skater on Venice Beach.
Two young girls from Tiffany's old sorority Kappa Omega Psi have been kidnapped to be sold as white slaves to a sheik, so Tiff and Kris return to college.
A game hunter who wants Charlie for his trophy case stalks the Angels in an attempt to force their elusive employer to surface.
Bosley's captaincy of Charlie's new luxury yacht is temporarily interrupted when the ship is stolen and then suddenly returned.
Tiffany's recently married college friend is afraid that something in her new husband's old house wants her out.
Two thieves abduct a police officer's battered son as part of a plan to stop robbery-witness Kelly from telling what she knows.

eps.t: One of Our Angels is Missing
eps.d: Kris poses as a rich divorcee to lure a handsome con man/jewel thief, unaware he is also a ruthless killer.
Kris poses as a hopeful starlet to find a teenage boy who vanished while trying to rescue his girlfriend from a porno producer.
Tiffany poses as a house seller to trap a real-estate agent whose sideline is burglary.
A brother comes to the Angels for help when his sister and dancing partner is kidnapped during a 1930s-style dance competition.
An electronics firm insists the Angels allow an eccentric private detective to lead their probe of several thefts.
A crazed escaped killer and his two sons take Jill hostage after she witnesses their robbery of a roadside shop in the desert.
The Angels infiltrate a clinic belonging to a plastic surgeon who has been forced to give a criminal a new face.
The Angels and Bosley assume several undercover guises to nab a con man who took three people's life savings.
Charlie calls in an old friend and her trio of supersleuths when he fears that an assassin is trying to kill all of the Angels.
Kelly is contacted by an attorney who tells her that his millionaire client is her true father.
Kelly becomes involved in an inheritance struggle when the man who might be her father dies.
The killing of a would-be model sends the Angels into the seamier side of the modeling world.
Model Julie Rogers joins the Angels to break a prostitution ring exploiting would-be models.
The Angels ask a psychic to help find Kris after she is abducted by a man blaming her for his wife's death.
A knife-waving diver attacks Kris and her new friend while they are searching for shipwrecks off Honolulu.
Julie's capture of an assassin who tried to kill a peace leader seems too easy, leading the Angels to think there is a partner.
The Angels go under cover as lifeguards to rescue a congressman's daughter from the dune-buggy riding men who kidnapped her.
The wife of a kidnapped Honolulu nightclub owner hires the Angels to make a fake ransom drop and nab the abductor.
The Angels try to prevent a profit-hungry New York businessman from setting two whiskey-running families at war with each other.
Kris poses as a con artist to trap a swindler who left town after cheating two sisters out of their inheritance.
The Angels step in when dangerous attempts to drive a cab company out of business threaten innocent lives.
A hostile call on a private phone in a singles club ends in murder when the threatened patron is run down in the parking lot.
A producer suspects sabotage when his choreographer and star performer vanish just before his show is to audition for Las Vegas.
The Angels pose as stuntwomen when a crossbow-wielding attacker descends upon a movie-remake set.
Julie becomes an unwitting accomplice in a hypnotist's plot to undermine a company and pave the way for a corporate takeover.
Twelve banks hire the Angels after 12 automatic-teller machines are emptied following the resignation of the devices' designer.
The Angels race against the clock to find the culprit behind several attempts on the life of a body-building-title contender.
A stakeout to nab a white-collar thief ends in tragedy when Kelly is shot in the head and given only even odds to live or die.
